title: Olive Fills the Gap
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 57-sound stage (dr, fl, fr just added).

pages.text: Olive sits in a gap in the oak.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl perched inside a hollow gap in the old oak tree.
A wide view of the empty hollow gap in the oak tree trunk.
Olive the owl peering around the bare inside of the hollow gap.
Olive the owl carrying a small tuft of soft white fluff in her beak.
Olive the owl carrying a flat wood chip in her beak.

pages.text: Olive gets a bit of moss.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl carrying a small clump of green moss in her beak.

pages.text: Olive fits it all in the gap.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl arranging the fluff, wood chip and moss inside the hollow gap.
The hollow gap now lined softly with fluff, moss and the flat chip.
Olive the owl sleeping snugly inside her softly lined hollow gap.
